AU.name: Australia
AU.source: S2: UNFCCC AU 2nd NDC 2025 (economy-wide pro-rata, workbook). S1/S3: rough IEA STEPS/NZE estimates, Tier C. Grid: Ember 2024. · S1 sectoral: DCCEEW Australia's emissions projections 2025 baseline, transport 99(2025)→83(2035), electricity 148→46 MtCO2e; 2025→2035 CAGR (82% RE 2030 가정). 2035 NDC 추가 감축분 부문 미배분.

CA.name: Canada
CA.source: S2: UNFCCC CA 2035 NDC Feb 2025 (economy-wide pro-rata, workbook). S1/S3: rough IEA STEPS/NZE estimates, Tier C. Grid: Ember 2024. · S1 sectoral: ECCC 2025 ERP Progress Report, With-Measures projection transport 157(2023)→124(2035), electricity 49→14 MtCO2e; 2023→2035 CAGR. CER 최종안은 2035 넷제로 그리드 아님(2050).

CN.name: China
CN.source: 2035 target vs undefined emissions peak — no S2 benchmark derivable (NOTES.md D3); excluded from S2 headline. S1/S3: rough IEA STEPS/NZE estimates, Tier C. Grid: Ember 2024.

EU.name: European Union
EU.source: S2: UNFCCC EU 2035 NDC (sectoral, workbook). S1/S3: rough IEA STEPS/NZE estimates, Tier C (ESTIMATES.md). Grid: Ember 2024. · S2 sectoral: SWD(2024)63 Pt.3 Table 3 (Fit-for-55 경로) domestic transport 795.6(2023, Eurostat env_air_gge)→583(2030), power&DH 573.8(CRF1A1A)→339 MtCO2e; 2023→2030 CAGR. 2035 부문치 공식 부재. PRIMES-CRF 정의차 ±0.5pp/yr.

IN.name: India
IN.source: GDP-intensity target — not an absolute emissions path (NOTES.md D3); excluded from S2 headline. S1/S3: rough IEA STEPS/NZE estimates, Tier C. Grid: Ember 2024.

JP.name: Japan
JP.source: S2: UNFCCC JP 2035 NDC (sectoral, workbook). S1/S3: rough IEA STEPS/NZE estimates, Tier C (ESTIMATES.md). Grid: Ember 2024. · S2 sectoral: 地球温暖化対策計画 (각의결정 2025-02-18) 運輸 190(FY2023)→146(FY2030), エネルギー転換(전기·열 배분후) 81.0→56 MtCO2; env.go.jp/content/000291669.pdf + 000310279.pdf. 2035 부문치 미공표 — FY2023→FY2030 CAGR 사용(2040 目安상 이후 더 가파름, 보수적).

KR.name: South Korea
KR.source: S2: UNFCCC KR 2035 NDC Dec 2025 (sectoral, workbook). S1/S3: rough IEA STEPS/NZE estimates, Tier C (ESTIMATES.md). Grid: Ember 2024. · S2 sectoral: 제1차 탄소중립·녹색성장 기본계획(2023.4) 연도별 경로 수송 88.7(2024)→61.0(2030), 전환 218.4→145.9 MtCO2eq; pcccr.go.kr. 2035 NDC(-53~61%)는 부문분해 미발표 — 2024→2030 CAGR 사용.

UK.name: United Kingdom
UK.source: S2: UNFCCC UK 2035 NDC Jan 2025 (sectoral, workbook). S1/S3: rough IEA STEPS/NZE estimates, Tier C (ESTIMATES.md). Grid: Ember 2024. · S2 sectoral: CCC 7th Carbon Budget Balanced Pathway (법정 자문, 정부 채택 아님) surface transport 102.8(2023)→36.98(2035), electricity supply 37.8→5.56 MtCO2e; full-dataset.xlsx, 2023→2035 CAGR.
